# creditor

Exploratory R bindings to [Loro](https://loro.dev), a Rust library of
conflict-free replicated data types (CRDTs). Replicas of a document edit
independently, exchange updates as raw vectors, and converge to the same
contents. Text (including rich text marks and cursors), map, list,
movable list, counter, and tree containers are supported, and they can
be nested. Documents keep their full history, which can be listed,
compared, checked out, and reverted. Exports can be full or shallow
snapshots, incremental updates, or JSON. Subscriptions report changes as
they are committed, an undo manager reverses local edits, and an
ephemeral store shares presence state such as cursors.

See
[`vignette("containers", package = "creditor")`](https://rundel.github.io/creditor/articles/containers.md)
for a tour of each container type and how it merges concurrent edits.

## Installation

Building from source needs a Rust toolchain: cargo and `rustc >= 1.85`.

``` r
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("rundel/creditor")
```

## Example

Editing functions return the document or container they were given, so
edits chain with the pipe.

Two replicas edit the same text concurrently and then merge.

``` r
library(creditor)

a = loro_doc() |>                    # replica `a` starts the text
  text_insert(1, "Hello")
b = loro_doc() |>                    # replica `b` starts from a snapshot of `a`
  doc_import(doc_export(a))

text_push(a, " world")               # concurrent edits, not yet synced
text_insert(b, 1, ">> ")

doc_merge(b, a) |>                   # each replica merges the changes it is missing
  text_get()
#> [1] ">> Hello world"

doc_merge(a, b) |>
  text_get()
#> [1] ">> Hello world"
```

[`doc_merge()`](https://rundel.github.io/creditor/reference/doc_sync.md)
is for replicas in the same R session. Replicas in different processes
send each other raw vectors instead:
`doc_export_updates(a, from = version)` holds the changes made to `a`
since a version the other replica reported with
[`doc_version()`](https://rundel.github.io/creditor/reference/doc_sync.md),
and
[`doc_import()`](https://rundel.github.io/creditor/reference/doc_sync.md)
applies them.

Containers nest: a map or list can hold plain values or child
containers, each of which merges independently. New containers are made
with
[`loro_text()`](https://rundel.github.io/creditor/reference/loro_text.md),
[`loro_list()`](https://rundel.github.io/creditor/reference/loro_text.md),
[`loro_map()`](https://rundel.github.io/creditor/reference/loro_text.md),
and friends, and stored like any other value.

``` r
doc = loro_doc()

note = doc_map(doc, "note") |>
  map_set(
    title = "Groceries",                   # plain value, replaced whole
    items = loro_list("milk", "eggs"),     # child containers merge their contents
    body = loro_text("Buy before Friday")
  )

list_push(note$items, "bread")             # edit a child container in place

doc |>
  doc_value() |>
  str()
#> List of 1
#>  $ note:List of 3
#>   ..$ body : chr "Buy before Friday"
#>   ..$ items:List of 3
#>   .. ..$ : chr "milk"
#>   .. ..$ : chr "eggs"
#>   .. ..$ : chr "bread"
#>   ..$ title: chr "Groceries"
```

The title is stored as a plain value: it changes only by being set
again, so when two replicas set it concurrently one of the values wins.
The items and body are containers, with handles (`note$items`,
`note$body`) that the `list_*` and `text_*` functions edit in place, and
concurrent edits to them from different replicas are all kept. The same
goes for R lists: `list("milk", "eggs")` would store a plain value that
comes back as an ordinary R list, which
[`list_push()`](https://rundel.github.io/creditor/reference/list.md)
cannot extend. Use plain values for things that change as a whole and
containers for things people edit piece by piece.

Text can carry marks, and a cursor keeps pointing at the same character
as the text changes.

``` r
doc = loro_doc() |>
  text_insert(1, "Hello world") |>
  text_mark(1, 5, bold = TRUE)             # "Hello" is bold

cursor = text_cursor(doc, 7)               # at the "w" of "world"

doc |>
  text_update("Hello brave new world") |>  # applies only the differences
  text_delta() |>                          # runs of text with their marks
  str()
#> List of 2
#>  $ :List of 2
#>   ..$ insert    : chr "Hello"
#>   ..$ attributes:List of 1
#>   .. ..$ bold: logi TRUE
#>  $ :List of 1
#>   ..$ insert: chr " brave new world"

cursor_pos(doc, cursor)                    # still at the "w", now character 17
#> [1] 17
```

Every version stays reachable.

``` r
doc = loro_doc(peer_id = 1) |>
  text_insert(1, "Hello") |>
  doc_commit("greeting") |>                # label each commit with a message
  text_push(" world") |>
  doc_commit("audience")

(changes = doc_changes(doc))               # one row per change
#> # A tibble: 2 × 7
#>   peer  counter lamport length timestamp message  frontiers
#>   <chr>   <int>   <int>  <int> <dttm>    <chr>    <list>   
#> 1 1           0       0      5 NA        greeting <4@1>    
#> 2 1           5       5      6 NA        audience <10@1>

doc |>
  doc_fork(at = "greeting") |>             # a copy at the "greeting" version
  text_get()
#> [1] "Hello"
```

Subscriptions make live sync a one-liner, and undo reverses only local
edits.

``` r
a = loro_doc()
b = loro_doc()

sync = doc_subscribe_local_updates(a, \(bytes) doc_import(b, bytes))  # send `a`'s updates to `b`
manager = doc_undo_manager(a)              # track `a`'s local edits

a |>
  text_insert(1, "Hello") |>
  doc_commit()                             # delivers the update to `b`
text_get(b)
#> [1] "Hello"

undo(manager)                              # undo is an edit too, so it syncs
text_get(b)
#> [1] ""

unsubscribe(sync)                          # stop syncing
```

## Shiny example

An example app shows two replicas of one document side by side. Each
pane can be taken offline to make concurrent edits, which merge when it
comes back online. Below the panes a timeline shows every edit as a
bubble, in one row per replica above an axis of edit times; hovering a
bubble shows what was changed and by whom, and selecting one shows the
text at that point with the edit’s insertions and deletions highlighted.

``` r
shiny::runApp(system.file("examples/sync-editors", package = "creditor"))
```

# Package index

## Documents

Create a document, identify its replica, and read its contents.

- [`loro_doc()`](https://rundel.github.io/creditor/reference/loro_doc.md)
  : Create a Loro document
- [`doc_peer_id()`](https://rundel.github.io/creditor/reference/doc.md)
  [`doc_set_peer_id()`](https://rundel.github.io/creditor/reference/doc.md)
  [`doc_fork()`](https://rundel.github.io/creditor/reference/doc.md)
  [`doc_commit()`](https://rundel.github.io/creditor/reference/doc.md)
  [`doc_value()`](https://rundel.github.io/creditor/reference/doc.md)
  [`doc_get()`](https://rundel.github.io/creditor/reference/doc.md)
  [`doc_jsonpath()`](https://rundel.github.io/creditor/reference/doc.md)
  : Document identity, replicas, and contents
- [`creditor`](https://rundel.github.io/creditor/reference/creditor-package.md)
  [`creditor-package`](https://rundel.github.io/creditor/reference/creditor-package.md)
  : creditor: R Interface to the Loro CRDT Library

Documents hold containers. Get a handle to a root container or create a
new one to store inside a map or list.

- [`doc_text()`](https://rundel.github.io/creditor/reference/containers.md)

  [`doc_counter()`](https://rundel.github.io/creditor/reference/containers.md)
  [`doc_tree()`](https://rundel.github.io/creditor/reference/containers.md)
  [`container_value()`](https://rundel.github.io/creditor/reference/containers.md)
  [`container_is_deleted()`](https://rundel.github.io/creditor/reference/containers.md)
  [`container_id()`](https://rundel.github.io/creditor/reference/containers.md)
  : Container handles
- [`loro_text()`](https://rundel.github.io/creditor/reference/loro_text.md)
  [`loro_map()`](https://rundel.github.io/creditor/reference/loro_text.md)

argument.

## Presence

document.
